dialogues.silence: "..." (Glares at you and turns away ignoring you).
dialogues.exact: "My grade, Prof {{playerName}}? I cleared the equation of my average and got exactly a {{grade}}, without a doubt."
dialogues.bracket: "Well, I'm not sure about the exact number, Prof {{playerName}}, but on the report card my performance was marked as {{bracket}}."

dialogues.t0: "You're the new Professor. Nice to meet you! Good luck with the puzzle left by the guy who left, I can't imagine having to decipher hidden grades to write the report! That man was crazy... I can help you with student {{studentId}}. You say they got a {{encryptedGrade}}... I taught them history, and I can tell you from experience that their performance is {{baremo}} in my classes. When your shift ends, do you want to grab a coffee with me and chat?"
dialogues.t1: "Ah, it's you! Welcome to the department. Don't listen to the rumors, this high school is quite peaceful. Is that note over there from student {{studentId}}? What a weird symbol, that {{encryptedGrade}}... Anyway, if it helps, in my subject they always stay in the {{baremo}} range."
dialogues.t2: "Sorry I'm in a rush, I have to print 40 exams! You're asking about student {{studentId}}? Oof, with that {{encryptedGrade}} I don't know what to tell you about their math, but in literature they are clearly a {{baremo}} kid. See you at recess!"
dialogues.t3: "Hey, colleague. You don't look so good, have you been staring at those combinations for a long time? If you're stuck with student {{studentId}} and their mysterious {{encryptedGrade}}, I advise you to treat them as a {{baremo}} student. They've rarely proven otherwise to me."
dialogues.t4: "Welcome! What a mess you've been handed with the encrypted records, right? I taught art to student {{studentId}}. I don't understand that {{encryptedGrade}}, but their general effort level is {{baremo}}. Good luck with the puzzle!"
dialogues.t5: "Shhh, keep your voice down, I'm grading. Student {{studentId}}? Yes, I know them. I don't care if it says {{encryptedGrade}} there, I'm sure their real level is {{baremo}}. Now let me finish this, please."
dialogues.t6: "Wow, the previous Professor in your position had a real 'Beautiful Mind' thing going on. For student {{studentId}}, ignore that {{encryptedGrade}}. Their academic record screams '{{baremo}}' all over. Cheers."
dialogues.t7: "Hello, Prof {{playerName}}! I was at the coffee machine. Do you need help with student {{studentId}}? That {{encryptedGrade}} would confuse anyone. If you ask me, I'd say they are {{baremo}}. Good luck with the rest!"
dialogues.t8: "You're the new one, right? I pity you, poor colleague. Is that {{encryptedGrade}} scribble from student {{studentId}}? What a headache. In physical education, their performance is {{baremo}}."
dialogues.t9: "Hey, Prof! If you're going to survive here you need instinct. Forget that {{encryptedGrade}}. Student {{studentId}} is a textbook case, clearly a {{baremo}}. Trust me, I've been here for 20 years."
dialogues.t10: "Nice to meet you. My goodness, are you still looking at the symbol table? Regarding student {{studentId}}, I can confirm that even if it says {{encryptedGrade}}, they always hover around a {{baremo}} scale."
dialogues.t11: "How's your day going, Prof {{playerName}}? Stuck with student {{studentId}}? That {{encryptedGrade}} is Greek to me, but knowing their study habits, they are a {{baremo}}. Don't give up!"
dialogues.t12: "Wow, the famous encrypted grades! I tried to decipher them and gave up. Good thing you're smart. I'll tell you that student {{studentId}} is {{baremo}}, regardless of that {{encryptedGrade}}."
dialogues.t13: "You look overwhelmed. Come on, sit down for a minute. Doubting student {{studentId}}? That {{encryptedGrade}} is crazy, but their real record says their attitude is {{baremo}}. Breathe, you'll figure it out."
dialogues.t14: "Hey, Prof. I just got out of a meeting with student {{studentId}}'s parents. I swear that {{encryptedGrade}} doesn't reflect their reality, which is purely {{baremo}}. I'm going to the staff room to rest."
dialogues.t15: "Hey, colleague! I see you staring at that {{encryptedGrade}}. Don't drive yourself crazy over student {{studentId}}. I taught them last year and they are definitely a {{baremo}}. Come on, pastries are on the house in the reception."
dialogues.t16: "You're the brave one who accepted the position, right? How heroic! About student {{studentId}}, I can only tell you that {{encryptedGrade}} covers up a performance of {{baremo}}. Good luck with the decryption!"
dialogues.t17: "Excuse me, do you have a spare red pen? Ah, thanks. By the way, if that {{encryptedGrade}} belongs to student {{studentId}}, I can confirm they are {{baremo}}. See you at the staff meeting."
dialogues.t18: "What a hieroglyph! Student {{studentId}} is not as complicated as that {{encryptedGrade}} seems. Treat them like a {{baremo}} student and you'll be spot on."
dialogues.t19: "Hi, are you Prof {{playerName}}? I was told you're deciphering the grades. To save you some trouble with student {{studentId}}: forget the {{encryptedGrade}}, evaluate them as {{baremo}}. Hugs and hang in there!"
